welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Phendula imibuzo embalwa malunga neempawu zakho. Ugqirha wakho uya kuhlolisisa yonke into ngaphambi kokuba udibane.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Oku kudibanisa utyelelo lwakho neerekhodi zakho.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Enkosi, {name}. Ndinento endiyifunayo. Makhe sihlolisise iimpendulo zakho ngaphambi kokuba uzithumele kugqirha.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Enkosi Ndiza kukubuza imibuzo embalwa emfutshane malunga nento ekwenze wangena.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Faka impendulo, okanye ucofe isindululo esikhankanywe ngasentla

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Nqakraza kuyo nayiphi na into ukuze uyilungise ngaphambi kokuba uyithumele.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Ukuba iimpawu zakho zinzulu okanye ziya zisiba mandundu ngoku, musa ukulinda tsalela iinkonzo zongxamiseko.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Nceda ufune uncedo kwisithuba seeyure eziyi-12

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Iimpawu zakho zibonisa into ekufuneka ibonwe kungekudala.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Iqela lezonyango lifumana imbali yakho echanekileyo ngoko nangoko.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Ukuba kuya kusiba mandundu, yenza ngokukhawuleza

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Ukuwohloka okunzulu okanye okungazelelwe tsalela iinkonzo zongxamiseko ngoko nangoko.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Sele zibambe iirekhodi zakho, ngoko iqela lakho lokunyamekela liya kubona imbali yakho epheleleyo ngoko nangoko.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Inkcazelo yakho ikwiqela lokunyamekela, siya kukuxelela xa ugqirha eyithetha.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Ukuba kuya kusiba mandundu, yenza into ngoku

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Musa ukulinda ukuma kwakho emgceni. Ukuba iimpawu zakho zinzulu okanye ziya zisiba mandundu ngesiquphe tsalela iinkonzo zongxamiseko kwangoku okanye uye kwisebe elikhawulezileyo leengxamiseko.

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Sibeke ityala lakho njengento ephambili ukuze iqela lokunyamekela likwazi oko.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Ugqirha uya kuhlolisisa ingxelo yakho, siza kukuhlaziya njengoko ihamba.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Phendula imibuzo embalwa malunga nendlela oye waba ngayo ukususela kutyelelo lwakho.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Isimo sakho sinjani xa sithelekiswa neyangaphambili?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?
checkinAnythingElse.translation: Ngaba ikho enye into ongathanda ukusixelela yona?

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Qhagamshelana neqela lakho lokunyamekela okanye uye kwisebe likaxakeka elikufutshane.

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Olu hlalutyo alukho. Ngena ukuze ubone ukungena kwakho kwangoku.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Ukubhalisa kwakho kuqinisekisiwe, yenza iakhawunti yasimahla yokulandelela olu tyelelo uze ushiye ikhowudi kwixesha elizayo.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Siza kuthumela ikhowudi yexesha elinye akukho phasiwedi yokukhumbula.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Ngenisa ifowuni yakho okanye i-imeyile kwaye siya kuthumela ikhowudi yokungena.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Iakhawunti yakho ixhunyiwe kwiirekhodi zesibhedlele sakho

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Impazamo yenethiwekhi, khangela uxhulumaniso lwakho uze uzame kwakhona.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Ngenxa yokhuseleko lwakho nokukhusela idatha yesigulana, uye wabhaliswa emva kwexesha ongasebenziyo.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Qalisa ukubhalisa ukuze uqalise utyelelo olutsha.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Iifowuni zonyango zihlale kule app · inombolo yakho yefowuni ayizange yabelwe.

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Khetha ukuba ngubani okufowunelayo nendlela abavakala ngayo.

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Ngokuthe ngqo, ngokuchanileyo, kungekho ntetho incinane

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Molo Jordan, lixesha ledatha yakho yasebusuku...

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Akukho zifowuni 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · iyabuyela kwisaziso

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Umgca wakho wokunyamekela uhlala usebenza ngena kwakhona ukuze ulawule iifowuni nezikhumbuzo.

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Umnxeba welizwi obhaliweyo · WebRTC · inombolo yakho ayikwazanga kwabelwana ngayo

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Akukho mfuneko yokunyamekela le ntlanganiso okwamanje.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Le ngqungquthela ekwabelwana ngayo nawe hayi ukuxilongwa. Ukuba izibonakaliso zakho ziyabuya okanye ziya zisiba mandundu, funa unyango olungxamisekileyo ngoko nangoko.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Lo tyelelo kusenokwenzeka ukuba lususiwe, okanye ikhonkco alisasebenzi. Buyela ukuze ubone imbali yakho epheleleyo.

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Gcina iinkcukacha zakho zihlaziyiwe, ugqirha wakho uza kubona izinto zakutshanje.

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Utshintsha ulwimi lwesikrini ngasinye ngoko nangoko.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Ayikwazanga ukukopa - khetha uze ukope ngesandla

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Igama lakho, iinkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano neempendulo zakho ezifumaneka simahla ziyasuswa ngaphambi kokuba nantoni na iphume esibhedlele sakho.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Vumela idatha engachazwanga ukuba iphucule ukhathalelo lomntu wonke. Ungakutshintsha oku nanini na.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Izikhumbuzo zexesha lokuqeshwa kunye nokuhlola okuqhubekayo ngokufowunela okanye ngokunyanzelisa. Unokutshintsha oku nanini na.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Ukususwa ngokusisigxina kweakhawunti yakho kunye neenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano. Imbali yakho yomgca wokunyamekela igcinwa sisibhedlele sakho njengoko kufunwa ngumthetho.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Cela ikopi yesishwankathelo sakho sokutyelela, amayeza akho nembali yakho yokufowunelwa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Oku kususa ngokupheleleyo iakhawunti yakho kunye neenkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano. Isibhedlele sakho sigcina imbali yakho yomgca wokunyamekela njengoko kufunwa ngumthetho. Oku akunakwenziwa.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Iqela lakho lokunyamekela liya kuqinisekisa nge-imeyile kwisithuba seeyure ezingama-72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Khetha ifomathi uze ucele ukuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe. Siza kuyilungiselela size sithumele ikhonkco elikhuselekileyo kwi-imeyile yakho ebhalisiweyo.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Siza kuthumela i-imeyile ikhonkco elikhuselekileyo kwidilesi yakho ebhalisiweyo kwisithuba seeyure ezingama-24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Akukho fayile ikhutshwe apha - iirekhodi zakho zithunyelwa ngokukhuselekileyo kwi-imeyile yakho ebhalisiweyo.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Ncamathisela ikhonkco lesimemo esithunyelwe sisibhedlele sakho, okanye ukhangele ikhowudi yabo yeQR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Oko akufani nekhonkco okanye ikhowudi yesimemo seTriavi.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Ikhowudi esebenzayo yekliniki ikukhokelela ngqo kwiinkcukacha zakho.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Ikhowudi yeklinikhi esebenzayo ikukhokelela ngqo kwiinkcukacha zakho.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Nika imvume yekhamera kwizilungiselelo zesikhangeli sakho, okanye ufake ikhonkco lokumema ngesandla.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Akukho khamera ifunyenweyo. Faka ikhonkco lesimemo esivela kwisibhedlele sakho.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Ikhamera ayifumaneki ngoku. Faka ikhonkco lokumema ngesandla.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Ukungaxhunyiwe kwi-intanethi? ukubonisa isicatshulwa sengxoxo esigciniweyo
